Elias turned the paper over, hoping for a name, a date, anything. There was only a small drawing of a gull. For weeks afterward, he scanned the horizon differently, as if the sea might return an explanation. It never did. Still, he wrote to Dingle and found the sister. Elias kept the drawing.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台尚未关尽的机器，低声运转。环卫工人的扫帚划过空荡的街道，红绿灯仍固执地为无人的路口变换颜色。写字楼里还亮着几盏灯，像深夜海面上零星的渔火。早点铺的蒸笼冒出第一缕白汽，地铁在地下深处醒来，发出遥远而沉闷的第一声轰鸣。流浪猫翻过矮墙，霓虹灯在积水里碎了又圆。这座城市正在黑暗中悄悄换气，把疲惫折叠起来，等待黎明把它重新擦亮，交给那些即将醒来的人。", "w03": "• Imagine standing between two facing mirrors: each reflection contains a smaller reflection, and that is how a function can call itself.\n• To keep it from going on forever, you need a stopping point, like the tiniest Russian doll that does not open.\n• Each call solves a small piece of the problem, and once the smallest piece is solved, all the bigger answers click into place on the way back up."}
